commenti.body: Stick with the moonlight, I think it be being purely moonlight is poetic and would work for you, may be hard to set up but worth it and it’s an obstacle you’ll have to overcome (filming the lighting) which would be useful for future works

You want to shoot with only moonlight? That's not possible. You have to replicate that with very subtle fill and key lighting and then colour correction. 

It's worth having a basic understanding of photography and lighting before embarking on shooting a film yourself.
